source_note: REAL DATA. ERCOT real-time settlement point prices (MIS report 13061, 15-minute intervals), load zones LZ_HOUSTON, LZ_NORTH, LZ_CPS, LZ_AEN, for each 2025 replay preset's Chicago-local date and the day after, plus the mock-only days (Jan 1-2 and Sep 14-20, 2025). Exported from data/snapshot/ercot_rt_2025_hubs.parquet by web/mock/export_prices.py. Everything else the mock API serves is simulated, including its 2026 prices (2025's, a year on) and prediction.
ts_note: ts_utc is the interval start in UTC; ts_local is the same instant in America/Chicago.
